auth.refresh: Our service account impersonated or keyed in customer project; short-lived tokens preferred over keys

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: none for service accounts (OAuth verification only if using user consent)
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Grant our service account dataset-level viewer plus a job-running role in a project that bills queries. Org policy may block external principals (domain-restricted sharing); admin must allow our domain/principal.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: Query cost: runs in OUR project (we pay) or customer project (customer pays) depending on where jobUser is granted

customer_grant_statements: Dataset read (Google docs SQL form): GRANT `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` ON SCHEMA `<customer_project>`.<dataset> TO "serviceAccount:loveleeday-reader@<LOVELEEDAY_PROJECT>.iam.gserviceaccount.com";
Google docs: roles/bigquery.dataViewer at dataset level lets principals 'Get metadata and permissions for the dataset' and 'Read (query), replicate, and export table data.'

Run queries: gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding <PROJECT_THAT_BILLS> --member=serviceAccount:loveleeday-reader@<LOVELEEDAY_PROJECT>.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.jobUser   (jobUser role named in Google doc; gcloud form is standard, not fetched verbatim)
Alternative: Analytics Hub listing shared to our project (UNVERIFIED, not fetched).

sandbox.how_to_get: BigQuery sandbox (no billing) in any Google Cloud project (UNVERIFIED not fetched)

rate_limits: Default 100 concurrent interactive queries per project (UNVERIFIED)
incremental_sync: Timestamp cursor on partitioned column; table snapshots/time travel; change history via CHANGES function (UNVERIFIED)
blockers: Customer org policy may restrict granting external service accounts
